navi.overlay.editorAnchors.description: After explicit problem navigation, locate NAVI's coloured editor beacon in the active VS Code client area for precise Windows flight (up to 20 seconds, at most 4 scans/second). No screenshots are saved or sent. Disable to keep only the editor marker.

navi.companion.enabled.description: Let NAVI make space during editor activity and offer bounded help. Files open only after an explicit action.

navi.companion.lifelike.description: React to editor, task, debug and interaction events with simulated attention, natural settling, pointer gaze and shared fairy gestures. No extra model requests or prompt scoring.

navi.memory.enabled.description: Enable explicitly confirmed preferences and workspace memories. NAVI does not automatically collect memories.

navi.bubble.enabled.description: Show transient speech bubbles beside NAVI for interaction events and short excerpts of NAVI's own chat replies.

navi.sound.enabled.description: Play original local fairy voice-like cues for greetings, discoveries, hints and celebration. No microphone or cloud service.

navi.fairy.animationEnabled.description: Enable NAVI's 110 coordinated movements and reactions, including ten additional greetings. Pauses while hidden.

navi.fairy.respectReducedMotion.description: Pause NAVI animations when the operating system requests reduced motion.

navi.history.enabled.description: Explicit opt-in: persist NAVI's own full prompts and responses locally. Never accesses Copilot's private history.

navi.history.maxEntries.description: Maximum stored opt-in NAVI chat exchanges.

navi.overlay.enabled.description: Show the local native foreground fairy on supported Windows x64 systems. The fairy hides when its VS Code window is inactive. No external service.

enumDescriptions: Balanced: up to 30 FPS while active, 15 FPS while hovering.
Eco: fewer sparkles and lower active frame rates.
navi.fairy.powerMode.description: Resource budget for the foreground fairy and the embedded preview.

scripts.compile: node scripts/native-motion-fixture.cjs --check && node scripts/generate-audio.cjs --check && node scripts/generate-expression.cjs --check && tsc -p .
scripts.check: node scripts/native-motion-fixture.cjs --check && node scripts/generate-audio.cjs --check && node scripts/generate-expression.cjs --check && tsc -p . --noEmit
scripts.package: npm run build:overlay && npm test && npm run verify:overlay && vsce package --no-dependencies
